I answered Dana in her #north-team thread: the settled seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 261. Ilse Varga posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14.

I also told Dana that the count before that was 185, set by Amendment No. 1 in August 2025. Dana had first posted it as 180 and corrected it to 185 a few minutes later. Seat counts aren't money terms, so the North team can see them.
